shortDescription: Tucson Chinese School Tucson Chinese School (TCS) was founded in 1950 over 63 years ago.
description: Tucson Chinese School Tucson Chinese School (TCS) was founded in 1950 over 63 years ago. After generations of hard work, TCS has become a major force in Southern Arizona Chinese education. The quality of teaching in TCS has improved quickly and has become the Southern Arizona Chinese education leader. TCS moved to the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center in 2005. This move allowed TCS to develop the best facilities, the strongest faculty, the highest quality of teaching, and the most complete grades in the Tucson area. Join us this semester to start or continue your language-learning journey. You may sign-up at any point throughout the year. Classes are offered for all levels. To sign up, fill out the registration form linked at the buttons below and send to info@tucsonchinese.org, or bring to the center during regular hours. Message From Our New Principal My name is Kai Chen. I earned my master's degree in Chinese Literacy from the University of Alberta, Canada, and have taught in the Chinese Immersion program at Sunrise Drive Elementary School for the past 11 years. I am very honored to serve as the principal of Tucson Chinese School, a program with nearly 100 years of history in our community. My vision is for TCS to be more than a place to learn the Chinese language. I hope to build a welcoming community where students, families, and teachers feel connected, and where students grow into confident, responsible learners with a strong appreciation of Chinese culture and a global perspective. Kai Chen TCS principal Additional Documents:
